# gloomberb Yahoo Finance client

Vendored from [gloom-sh/gloomberb](https://github.com/gloom-sh/gloomberb), MIT,
commit [`0dafb31`](https://github.com/gloom-sh/gloomberb/commit/0dafb31).

LaVega keeps the Yahoo session/crumb flow, retry policy, symbol suffix mapping,
chart response types, and chart mappers. Upstream application-specific
time-series and fundamentals types were replaced by LaVega adapter types.
